property_summary: For any caller and any amount _am, if the caller's balance can cover the withdrawal (i.e. CashOut's guard admits it) then the caller's balance must strictly decrease by _am; the mutant's strict '<' guard rejects the equality case _am == balance, so a withdrawal equal to the balance leaves the balance unchanged instead of zero.
change_summary: Changed the CashOut guard from `_am <= balances[msg.sender]` to `_am < balances[msg.sender]`, rejecting the equality case and thereby changing whether the subtraction/state update can execute.
